title.en: Which printed window fits this check: which secondary-structure pumps print 1–3 cm stone
title.zh: 这一问只对一个窗口：哪些二次结构泵印了 1–3 厘米石子

description.en: Taken from the printed row: Three of the four secondary-structure rows. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 1–3 cm on Electric 15, the rural diesel pump and the tractor-driven 4100. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 10 Series prints 2 cm and below on that same application list. Read it in the Xingtai table. A 4 cm stone is outside all four. Taken from the printed row: The integrated mixer prints 4 cm and below, but its scenario is mix-and-pump, not the secondary-structure sentence.
description.zh: 四行二次结构里的三行。河北品锦机械（邢台）在电动15、农村柴油泵和拖拉机带动4100上印了 1–3 cm。电动10系列在同一份应用名单上印的是 2 cm 及以下。4 cm 石子不在这四行里。搅拌泵一体机印了 4 cm 及以下，但它的工况是搅拌加泵送，不是二次结构那一句。

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Centrifugal Pumps (Roto-dynamic pumps)” from “Pumps - Classifications”, then stays with the cells already published. Taken from the printed row: Electric 15, the rural diesel and the tractor-driven 4100 print 1–3 cm. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 1–3 cm on Electric 15, the rural diesel pump and the tractor-driven 4100. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The integrated mixer prints 4 cm and below, but its scenario is mix-and-pump, not the secondary-structure sentence. Keep this cell as published. The 4100 is 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h and 40–100 m / 15–45 m, with slump 180–220 mm. Taken from the printed row: A secondary-structure mix at 3 cm does not move onto the 80 mm Electric 20 pipe. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No pressure cell is printed on Electric 15. Keep this cell as published. No. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/classification-pumps-d_55.html
body.zh: 本节保留《Pumps - Classifications》的标题“离心泵组动泵组”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。目录里已经写着：电动15、农村柴油泵和拖拉机带动4100印了 1–3 cm。同一份二次结构名单上的电动10系列印的是 2 cm 及以下。按邢台表上的原文理解：它的工况是建筑与商业浇筑。3 cm 的二次结构料不能挪到 80 mm 的电动20管上。1–2 cm 的料，只有在管路已经离开紧凑距离之后，才可以在那里讨论。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动15没有印压力格。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/classification-pumps-d_55.html

body.en: The section shape comes from “Positive Displacement Pumps” in “Pumps - Classifications”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Keep this cell as published. Electric 10 Series, on the same secondary-structure list, prints 2 cm and below. Taken from the printed row: Electric 10 Series prints 2 cm and below on that same application list. Read it in the Xingtai table. Electric 15 needs a grid for 15 kW and prints 60–80 m horizontal and 15–20 m vertical at 8–10 m³/h. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Shared stone size does not share distance. Keep this cell as published. A mix at 1–2 cm might be discussed there only after the pipe has left the compact distances. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. They are different pages. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Match stone, distance and power.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Pumps - Classifications》的“容积位移泵组”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。这一格照已印出的读：四行二次结构里的三行。邢台河北品锦机械在电动15、农村柴油泵和拖拉机带动4100上印了 1–3 cm。电动10系列在同一份应用名单上印的是 2 cm 及以下。4 cm 石子不在这四行里。搅拌泵一体机印了 4 cm 及以下，但它的工况是搅拌加泵送，不是二次结构那一句。目录里已经写着：请发送石子厘米数，以及现场有没有电网。按邢台表上的原文理解：它们是不同的页面。电动30是建筑泵，有单独的细石和 13 骨料距离，不是二次结构那句话。

heading.en: Selecting between Centrifugal or Positive Displacement Pumps
heading.zh: 之间离心容积位移泵组

body.en: “Pumps - Classifications” breaks its subject at “Selecting between Centrifugal or Positive Displacement Pumps”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Three of the four secondary-structure rows. Keep this cell as published. A 4 cm stone is outside all four. Taken from the printed row: The rural diesel is 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal and 10–30 m vertical. Read it in the Xingtai table. Its scenario is building and commercial placement. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Send the stone in centimetres and whether the site has grid power. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. Taken from the printed row: Electric 30 is a building pump with separate fine-stone and aggregate-13 distances, not the secondary-structure sentence. Headings already printed: Electric 20 is 1–2 cm and not this sentence
body.zh: 《Pumps - Classifications》在“之间离心容积位移泵组”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动15需要能供给 15 kW 的电网，并印了水平 60–80 m、垂直 15–20 m、8–10 m³/h。农村柴油泵是 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m。4100 是 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、40–100 m / 15–45 m，坍落度 180–220 mm。石子相同不等于距离相同。这一格照已印出的读：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。目录里已经写着：没有。对照石子、距离和动力。已印出的标题：电动20是 1–2 cm，而且没有这句话

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No pressure cell is printed on Electric 15.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：电动15没有印压力格。
